summary: Sixteen days to the FreightWorks Expo (Nov 4). Maya declared Smart Slots the company-wide focus. The slot picker and scoring API are waiting on Sam's final screens and Nina's ranking. Sync errors are at 1.6%, above the 1% target. The Harbor QBR is Thursday. The third design partner is not signed.

items.text: Maya decided Smart Slots is the priority for everyone until Expo on Nov 4. Harbor's 5,000-row export limit and the sync error work are deferred until after Expo unless sync gets worse.
Sam promised the final slot picker screens (TW-118) today by 3pm, then starts the Expo demo flow (TW-119).
Leila is building the slot picker (TW-117) on placeholder screens and needs Sam's final designs from TW-118 to finish.
Nina committed to deliver the recommendation ranking (TW-116) by Wednesday (Oct 21); ticket due Oct 27.
Arjun's slot-scoring endpoint (TW-115) passes on test data, but real recommendations can't be wired in until Nina's ranking (TW-116) lands.
Arjun asked Nina for the ranking (TW-116) by Wednesday so he can wire it into the scoring API.
Nina agreed to pull Q3 usage numbers for Harbor's QBR deck (TW-128) by tomorrow; ticket due Oct 21.
Jordan is building the Harbor QBR deck (TW-112) for Thursday Oct 22, and needs Nina's usage numbers.
Harbor renewal order form went out Friday Oct 16; Dana called the renewal routine. Renewal date is Oct 30.
Sync error rate was 1.6% on Oct 18, above the 1% target, mostly Ridgeline duplicates (TW-103). Maya will revisit after Expo unless it worsens. Ridgeline renews Nov 20.
Coastal can go live once the API is stable. Valley is still sorting out data access on their side. TW-121 is due Oct 30.
Coastal and Valley need API endpoint docs (TW-127, Arjun, due Oct 26) before they can go live.
Harbor asked again about the 5,000-row CSV export limit (TW-102); Jordan told them it is on the list. Deferred until after Expo.
Third Smart Slots design partner (Pinecrest Grocers, TW-126, Maya, due Oct 30) is not yet signed, and the launch goal needs 3 partners live.
Booth design review with Sam is Wednesday; Expo invites go out Friday. Maya also has the investor update (TW-111) due Oct 23.
Nina is on call this week (Oct 19).
